}}'''Murel''' is a soldier in the [[Seanchan]] army.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Murel}}

== Appearance ==
He has tilted eyes and honey-colored. He is hard and lean.

== Activities ==
He is part of a Seanchan troop that stops outside the town of [[Jurador]].
He means to enter [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show]] without paying when he is stopped by the Standard-bearer and sent back to camp before any trouble starts.
